Direct event-type funnel count: 13 PAYMENT_ROUTED but 0 SETTLEMENT_COMPLETE -- clean stall at the settlement stage
Searched full event set for any Kafka-related/lag messages (the confound this fault type is designed to test for) -- zero matches
reasoning_trace: Witness monitor independently flagged settlement DOWN then RECOVERED. Funnel count shows 13 payments reached PAYMENT_ROUTED but zero reached SETTLEMENT_COMPLETE -- a clean stall at settlement, the same shape as prior SETTLEMENT_DB_FAILURE_* rounds. Explicitly checked for the misleading Kafka-related secondary symptom this fault type is named for (the standing project thesis being tested: is the confound risk real or rare) -- found no Kafka/lag-related log lines anywhere in the evidence bundle. No competing hypothesis was suggested by the evidence. Conclusion reached from evidence alone, before reading the injector's own log: settlement.
confirmation_basis: Blind conclusion (settlement) matches the injector's own ground-truth log exactly. Fourth clean replication of this confound type with no misleading symptom observed -- consistent with, and further statistical support for, the standing finding that the confound risk is real in principle but rare in practice on this infra.
